complete_examples.text: However, these models still have some limitations in some aspects.17 Inspired by the work of Zhu et al.,18 a fractional derivative element in parallel with an elastic element is employed in the SFD model.

The SFD model for the rubber bearing has been developed in the form of paralleled fractional derivative element and elastic element by considering the stochastic parameters based on the fractional calculus, the NTM, and the PDEM.
